name: gmx-cypher roles
about: The role layer over Morpheus's tokens.json (copied verbatim): where gmx-cypher's colour roles differ from Morpheus (docs/design-contract.md §2, T159). Generated into tokens.css with tokens.json by scripts/tokens.ts.

tokens.name: state
tokens.usage: UI state, as an ink fill: the selected toggle, the primary action, the active tab. Never data.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Morpheus's primary action, here in ink: coral is a group's hue.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Errors, failed and armed destructive actions only. At least 0.10 apart in OKLab from every tone, ring and primary.

tokens.name: ramp-0
tokens.usage: Ordered series (time, ξ, RMSF), first stop; interpolated in OKLCH. At least 3:1 on every ground.
